titre: Practice test — English (5th year primary) — Term 1

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

My name is Youssef. I am eleven years old. I am in the fifth year. My school is not far from my house. It has a big playground and a small library. My classroom is on the ground floor. I have ten classmates. My favourite subject is Sport. I like my teacher, Mr Ali, because he is patient.

Questions:
1) What is his name? (1 pt)
2) Where is his classroom? (1 pt)
3) What is his favourite subject? (1 pt)
4) Why does he like his teacher? (1 pt)
5) True or False: His school is far from his house. (1 pt)
6) True or False: His library is small. (1 pt)

Vocabulary - Match
Match each object with the right room:
a) fridge
b) wardrobe
c) bath
d) television
( bedroom / bathroom / kitchen / living room )
